limitations: Synthetic fixture acceptance is software validation, never biological, physical, causal or clinical validation.
The unadjusted log2(CPM+1) Welch reference does not model count dispersion, paired donors or covariates, and cannot establish power or independent replication.
Hash-bound input and freeze declarations cannot independently prove historical timing or actual source independence.

Statistical-only claims cannot establish binding, affinity, inhibition, activation or mechanism; case-insensitive whole-word families bind, affinit, inhibit, activat and mechanis are refused alongside causal, therapeutic, clinical and efficacy wording, even in negations.
Conservative wording checks cannot adjudicate every paraphrase; coordinator-owned independent source, record and method review remains mandatory.
